summary: Verified two web layout fixes on Expo/React Native web preview. (1) On desktop viewport 1600x900, ALL requested pages have their main content wrapped in a container with maxWidth: 1200px, alignSelf: center — verified via getBoundingClientRect + getComputedStyle. Measured wrapper: x=320, width=1200, maxWidth='1200px', alignSelf='center' on tenant-dashboard, /history, /new-bill, /expenses, /manage, /platform, /platform-users, and /tenant-detail. Left margin = 320 (240 sidebar + 80 free), right margin = 80, so content is centered inside the visible area right of the sidebar. (2) DesktopSidebar navItem has cssGap='16px' and navLabel marginLeft='4px' → effective icon↔text spacing = 20px, exceeding the 16px minimum requirement. (3) /tenant-detail AND /platform-users both render the DesktopSidebar (mode='platform') on desktop — confirmed via [data-testid='desktop-sidebar'] element present. (4) /platform tenants-table (x=336, w=1168) stays inside the 1200px cap. (5) Mobile viewport 390x844 shows NO desktop-main wrapper, NO desktop-sidebar, bodyWidth=390 (full width) and NO element with maxWidth:1200px is applied — mobile layout preserved without regression. All 8 test cases from the review request PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: In tenant-detail.tsx and platform-users.tsx the desktopContent wrapper is nested inside a SafeAreaView which itself already has flex:1. There is a second matching div with w=0 h=0 in the DOM (harmless duplicate from the styling chain) — the actual visible wrapper is correct (x=320, w=1200). No functional impact.

Consistent pattern used across all screens (styles.desktopContent = {flex:1, width:'100%', maxWidth:1200, alignSelf:'center'}) — good DRY candidate for a shared component in /app/frontend/src/components/DesktopContentWrapper.tsx if this pattern grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two web layout fixes fully verified. All 8 test cases pass. Login flow requires [data-testid='login-email-input'], [data-testid='login-password-input'], [data-testid='login-submit-button']. Use force=True on clicks. On desktop the wrapper is [data-testid='desktop-main'] > firstChild for tenant tab routes; for /platform, /tenant-detail, /platform-users each screen owns its own maxWidth:1200 wrapper (find via getComputedStyle maxWidth='1200px' && alignSelf='center'). Sidebar nav items use data-testid='sidebar-{key}' and CSS gap=16px + navLabel marginLeft=4px.
